faqs.q: 1. What is the purchase procedure for Daudsons Armoury firearms?
faqs.a: Residents of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa require a valid KP License/Demand note; residents elsewhere in Pakistan require a valid All-Pakistan License/Demand note. Direct purchases can be completed at our factory outlet at Small Industrial Estate, Kohat Road, Peshawar 25210, KPK, or via authorized dealers.

faqs.q: 2. Where are your authorized dealers located?
faqs.a: Authorized dealers are located in Abbottabad, Islamabad/Rawalpindi, Lahore, Faisalabad, Multan, Khanewal, Quetta, and Karachi, in addition to our Peshawar factory outlet.

faqs.q: 3. What calibers and firearm types are manufactured by Daudsons Armoury?
faqs.a: We manufacture 9mm pistols (including DSA Trushot and DSA NINE), 30 bore pistols, 12-gauge pump-action shotguns, 12-gauge double barrels (both external and internal hammer), and .223 rifles.

faqs.q: 4. Can firearms or parts be delivered to my home or address?
faqs.a: No. There is strictly no delivery for any product or part requiring a valid firearms license. However, delivery can be arranged for non-restricted accessories and official merchandise.

faqs.q: 5. Do you provide firearm maintenance and repair services?
faqs.a: Yes, comprehensive maintenance and repair services are provided at our Peshawar factory.

faqs.q: 6. What are the terms of the DSA Warranty?
faqs.a: One year warranty with parts, covering manufacturing defects only (not misuse or negligence). The warranty is valid only at DSA factory premises in Peshawar; transportation is the responsibility of the dealer or customer.

faqs.q: 7. How long are spare parts guaranteed to be available?
faqs.a: Spare parts availability is guaranteed for 5 years, on payment.

faqs.q: 8. What is the recommended cleaning procedure?
faqs.a: Always clean the weapon after firing per internationally accepted firearm maintenance procedures.

faqs.q: 9. What factory customization options are offered?
faqs.a: We offer custom color finishes, hard chrome plating, gold plating, artisan engraving, and custom barrel length options.

faqs.q: 10. What is the rated barrel life of DSA firearms?
faqs.a: Rated barrel life is 10,000 rounds for pistols and 5,000 rounds for shotguns.

faqs.q: 11. Where are all DSA weapons made?
faqs.a: All weapons are proudly made in Peshawar, Pakistan.

faqs.q: 12. What are the differences between the GEN2 and GEN1 Trushot?
faqs.a: GEN2 introduces 10 refinements over GEN1: redesigned grip, trigger guard serrations, weight reduction in the alloy frame, improved catches for safety/slide release/retainer, improved trigger geometry, reduced trigger travel (later GEN2 only), improved parts interchangeability, magazine well bevel (later GEN2 only), improved edge finish on slide/hammer/catches, and discontinuation of the DSA Scratchless coating on the frame.

faqs.q: 13. How does the DSA NINE compare to the DSA TRUSHOT?
faqs.a: TRUSHOT has an external hammer, aluminum frame, manual safety, and double action (DA/SA). DSA NINE has an internal hammer, polymer frame, manual plus trigger safety, and single action (SA).
Yes, an in-house firing facility is available at the Peshawar factory.
